doc: Recorded by `atd record --capability reader.turtle` from the RDF module's parser and family findings on the body that parity/cases/w3c/skos/layered-schemes.json of etalii.adp.ide.desktop opens; never edited by hand.

input.body:
@prefix : <http://example.org/kinds#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .

:zoo a skos:ConceptScheme ; skos:prefLabel "Zoo"@en .
:farm a skos:ConceptScheme ; skos:prefLabel "Farm"@en .
:empty a skos:ConceptScheme ; skos:prefLabel "Empty"@en .

:animal a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "animal"@en ; skos:inScheme :zoo , :farm ; skos:topConceptOf :zoo .
:bird a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "bird"@en ; skos:inScheme :zoo ; skos:broader :animal .
:mammal a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "mammal"@en ; skos:inScheme :zoo ; skos:broader :animal .
:bat a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "bat"@en ; skos:inScheme :zoo ; skos:broader :mammal , :bird .
:species01 a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "species 1"@en ; skos:inScheme :zoo ; skos:broader :mammal .
:species02 a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "species 2"@en ; skos:inScheme :zoo ; skos:broader :mammal .
:species03 a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "species 3"@en ; skos:inScheme :zoo ; skos:broader :mammal .

:species20 a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "species 20"@en ; skos:inScheme :zoo ; skos:broader :mammal .
:cow a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "cow"@en ; skos:inScheme :farm ; skos:broader :animal .
:left a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "left"@en ; skos:inScheme :farm ; skos:broader :right .
:right a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "right"@en ; skos:inScheme :farm ; skos:broader :left .
:stray a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "stray"@en .
:lost a skos:Concept ; skos:prefLabel "lost"@en ; skos:broader :stray .
:pets a skos:Collection ; skos:prefLabel "pets"@en ; skos:member :bat , :cow .
:herd a skos:Collection ; skos:prefLabel "herd"@en ; skos:member :cow .
